about: Real phrasings for the composer (CHAT_PLAN 'Phrasing tests from real conversations'): user turns from CLINC150 (CC BY 3.0) small talk, out-of-scope, reminder, to-do and calendar acts, PTO and meeting questions; WildChat (ODC-BY) general-knowledge questions; Schema-Guided Dialogue (CC BY-SA 4.0) alarm, weather and events requests. Names are replaced. Each is asked through /chat/stream with no model over voice_1110.json's notebook at its fixed clock. Raw sets are not in the repo; see SOURCES.md.
